written: 2026-10-30, phase 7j-a, before any of the phase's computations; the ranges are declarations with their sources, not fits, and are never widened after a result

tube_radius.source: the 1/4-inch tube's nominal inner diameter (6.35 mm); an extruded silicone tube's diameter tolerance of order +-0.15 mm (inference; nothing measured)

body_radius.source: FL-9's R_cyl (de Jongh et al. 2025, text and Table 1); a printed part's tolerance of order +-50 um (inference; nothing measured)

wavenumber.source: FL-9's nu (Table 1); +-0.05, a print's twist off by about 2% (inference)

modulation.source: FL-9's epsilon (Table 1); the crest's height epsilon R = 0.51 mm to +-50 um (inference)

viscosity.source: water from 30 to 18 degC (IAPWS R12-08, the formulation of A's record arm); the temperature is not reported, and A's 1.0 mPa s is about 20 degC

margin.source: A's contact margin, a setting with no physical source (P-13); the range is P-13's sweep. A physical value (a film or the roughness, P-4) is of order microns, below every rung's resolution here: the column is a local linear reading at 0.1 mm, not a band

moment.source: A's two magnets of 8.4e-4 (the 0.2 line); one magnet alone (G0's verified 8.4e-4); two 1 mm N45 cubes at the grade's middle remanence, 2 x 1.345 T x 1e-9 m^3 / mu_0 = 2.14e-3 (A's record arm)

amplitude.source: 1.2 mT measured with no stated band; a rotating dipole's field below it is elliptical, its components about 2:1 (inference)

body_density.source: A's mean density (the 0.2 line's 410 + 1000); a printed resin of 1100 to 1250 kg/m^3 with two 1 mm^3 N45 cubes (7500 kg/m^3) in FL-9's 60.2 mm^3 (inference)

water_density.source: water from 30 to 18 degC is 995.6 to 998.6 kg/m^3 (IAPWS); A's 1000 is its upper end

viscosity.source: as on the BEM rung: the worked example's check in the dynamics

transverse_inertia_scale.source: A's I_eff is m R^2 / 2 about every axis; a solid cylinder's transverse inertia is m (3 R^2 + L^2) / 12, 4.32 times that, for FL-9's R and L

margin.source: as on the BEM rung (P-13's sweep)

body_radius: umr.extent (the contact, (1 + modulation) R, frozen at build)
umr.mass, umr.inertia, gravity:umr.buoyant_volume (declared, not derived from the shape)
modulation: drag:umr.shape_modulation (bem); none on the surrogate (outer_radius only)
length: the declared mass and volume (not derived)
